chapters.title: One day Mum and Dad took…
p: One day, Mum and Dad took Lily to the park. She was very excited! She loved being in the fresh air and watching the trees and the birds.
Lily saw a funny looking man wearing a big red cap. It was very interesting! She wanted to have a look at it. The man smiled at her and said "Hello Lily!"
Lily asked the man if she could try on his cap. He said yes, so she put it on her head. She felt so happy!
As the sun went down, Mum said it was time for Lily to take a nap. Lily said goodbye to the man, and as she walked away she was wearing her special cap.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a hero who was brave and strong. She was always ready to help those who were in need.
One day the hero was walking through the town when she heard a loud yelling. She looked around and saw a little boy, pushing against a wall but he couldn’t move it.
The hero rushed to help him, but she was surprised when the boy thanked her before she had even done anything. The hero then leaned against the wall and it quickly moved away. The boy was so happy!
The hero smiled and said, “You’re a brave and strong little boy! You didn’t need me after all!”
The boy thanked the hero again and said, “You are a real hero!”
The hero smiled and said, “We all can be heroes when we try our best!”

chapters.title: One day Lucy went to the…
p: One day, Lucy went to the park with her mom. While she was there, Lucy saw a judge in her red robe. She thought it was so cool and wanted to get a closer look. As Lucy got closer, she started to yell. The judge looked at her. Lucy felt embarrassed.
Her mom saw what had happened and quickly ran over. She told Lucy not to yell at the judge and said that it was not nice. Lucy hung her head down and talked quietly.
The judge smiled and told Lucy that it was ok. She thought it was funny that Lucy was so excited. Then the judge waved and walked away.
Lucy felt much better, but was still a bit embarrassed. It was a good lesson to remember to think before you yell.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a mushroom who lived in the forest. One day, he felt something strange near him - it was a stick! The mushroom was scared, but he decided to take a closer look. As he got closer, he saw that somebody was stirring the ground with it. It was the terribly bad fox! He wanted to take the mushroom for dinner.

The mushroom was so scared, he didn’t know what to do! Suddenly, he heard a voice from above saying, “Mushroom, don’t worry, I’m here to help you!” The voice belonged to a wise old owl who flew down from the tree and scared the fox away.
The mushroom was so thankful for the owl’s help! From that day on, the fox never dared to stir near the mushroom’s home. The mushroom was safe and happy again!

chapters.title: Once there was a little boy…
p: Once there was a little boy called Sam. Every day Sam's Mum made him wash his hands and face so he was always very clean.
After Sam had washed, he always had a delicious dessert. His favourite was chocolate ice cream. He really loved to eat it.
Sometimes Sam liked to play in the park. His favourite thing to do was to run around and jump on the bouncy castle, but sometimes it could get very boring.
But Sam wasn't ever bored for long. His Mum always found something exciting for them to do. He was always very happy and enjoyed every day.

chapters.title: Once there was a little farmer…
p: Once there was a little farmer who had a grumpy cow. The cow didn't like to eat the grass in the farmer's field. The farmer felt bad for the cow, so he decided to restore the grass and make it look nice again.
The farmer got to work and began to cut down the old grass and plant new ones. After a few days the farmer was finished. The grass looked so lively and green, it made the farmer very happy.
The cow was also happy when it saw the new grass. She was no longer grumpy when she ate the fresh and tasty grass.
Everyday the farmer and his cow would go for long walks in the now restored field. They were both very happy and healthy.

chapters.title: One day a pilot was flying…
p: One day, a pilot was flying high in the sky. He was very foolish and decided to do a dangerous display in the air. He flew around and around, doing loops and flips. Everyone on the ground was amazed.

Suddenly, the pilot made a big mistake and started to fly really fast. He had gone too far and it seemed like he would never come back. Everyone watched in fear, but then, something wonderful happened.
The pilot flew back into view! But now he was upside down. Everyone cheered for his daring and foolish display.
The pilot smiled and waved. He was very brave, and everyone was happy he was safe. They knew he was a very special pilot indeed!

chapters.title: Once there was a girl Her…
p: Once there was a girl. Her name was Sue. One day, Sue was walking past an office. She looked inside and saw a delicate lady. Sue questioned why the lady was in the office.
The next day, Sue went back to the office to find out the answer. The lady said she was there to do some important work. Sue questioned what kind of work and the lady smiled.
The lady told Sue she was looking after some delicate flowers. Sue asked if she could help. The lady said yes and showed Sue how to take care of them.
Then, every day, Sue and the lady looked after the flowers together. Sue was very happy to learn how to be delicate with the flowers.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was an old star in the sky. It was very special, because it was the oldest star in the universe. Every night, the old star shone so brightly that it lit up the whole sky.

The old star was so magical that it could grant wishes. One day, a little girl saw the old star in the night sky. She made a wish that she could write like a grown up. Suddenly, the old star sparkled and her wish came true.

The little girl was so happy that she ran to get a pencil and paper. She wrote and wrote and wrote. Soon, the little girl was writing stories about the old star in the sky. She wrote about all of its magic and how brightly it shone.
The little girl was thankful to the old star for making her wish come true. Every night, she would look up to the sky and say "Thank you!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a boy named Sam. He was a very selfish boy.
Sam had a herb garden that he liked to take care of. Every day he would part the herbs and make sure they were all taken care of.
But one day when he looked in his herb garden, it was all gone! All of the herbs had been taken by a selfish person.
Sam was very sad and angry. He knew he had to get his herbs back.
He searched and searched until he found the person who had taken his herbs. He asked them why they had taken them and the person said they just wanted something to grow in their own garden.

Sam was still sad and a little angry, but he realized that the person had only done it because they wanted something for themselves. Sam decided to be generous and gave them some of his herbs to grow in their own garden.
The person was very happy and thanked Sam for his generosity. From then on, Sam made sure to be less selfish and to share his herbs with everyone.

chapters.title: Mummy and Daddy were very excited…
p: Mummy and Daddy were very excited. It was time to celebrate!
They put on their warm coats and hats. Then they took Copper outside. Copper was their little puppy.
The day was very icy. Snow was everywhere! Daddy held Copper's leash tightly, and they set off to celebrate.
They went to the park and there were lots of families there too. There was loud music and yummy food! Everyone was wearing bright colours.
Copper was very excited to be there. He ran around and played with the other puppies.
At the end of the day, Mummy, Daddy, and Copper were so tired. But they had lots of fun! They were all so happy to have celebrated together.

chapters.title: The sun was high in the…
p: The sun was high in the sky and the day was hot. Suddenly, it started to rain. The drops of rain were big and heavy. Emily looked up at the sky, excitedly. She opened her mouth and let the raindrops hit her tongue. They tasted cool and sweet.
Next, Emily went outside and saw a puddle of orange water. She smiled and went closer. She picked up a small dish and scooped up some of the water. She played with it, making figures in the mud.

The rain stopped, but Emily stayed outside. She played with her dish of orange water, until it disappeared in the sun. Emily was happy and covered in mud. But she also had a big smile on her face. She knew that it would rain again soon.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a crazy rod. It was so special because it could create things. Every day it would create something new and amazing. One day it created a giant tree filled with candy. Everyone was so excited!

The candy fell from the branches and filled the sky. Everyone was happy and they ate so much candy. But then the rod created a volcano and a big fire came out. Everyone was scared and started running.
But then the rod created a big monster made of ice cream! Everyone smiled and laughed then the monster gave everyone a hug.
The rod kept creating new and amazing things every day. That's why it was so special and so crazy. Everyone loved it and they were so happy!

chapters.title: George was walking through the forest…
p: George was walking through the forest when he heard a loud noise. He looked up and saw a big, filthy crane in the sky. The bird was flapping its wings, making a loud sound. George was scared and started to shiver. He stood there, shaking, until the crane flew away.
When the crane was gone, George noticed something glimmering in the dirt. He walked over and picked it up - it was a gold coin! He put it in his pocket and headed home, feeling much less scared.

When George got home, he showed his mom the gold coin. She was so excited, she hugged George and told him what a good job he did. Even though George was still a little bit scared of the crane, he couldn't help but smile.

chapters.title: Once there was a humble worm…
p: Once there was a humble worm who wanted to get a hug. He crawled up to a little boy and squeazed up against his leg. The little boy was surprised and laughed. He scooped up the worm in his hands and gave him a big squeeze. The worm felt so happy and he wriggled with joy.

The little boy put the worm on the ground and they spent the rest of the afternoon playing together. The little boy showed the worm his ball and they ran around trying to catch it. The worm would get so close to the ball and then the little boy would pick him up and give him a squeeze.

At the end of the day the little boy said goodbye to the worm. He waved as he walked away and the worm waved back with his two little arms. The humble worm said goodbye to his friend, happy to have had such a wonderful day.

chapters.title: Randy was a little boy He…
p: Randy was a little boy. He was only three years old. He played with his toys all day long.
One day he found a gun in his backyard. He thought it was cool and started to play with it. His mom saw him from the window and got very scared. She called the police.
The police came quickly. They saw what Randy was doing and told him it was not safe. They took the gun away and put it in a sack.
Randy was very sad. He tried to explain to the police that he was only playing but they did not listen. They said it was foolish of him to play with a gun.
Randy was sad but he understood why the police took the gun away. He learned a valuable lesson that day - not to play with guns. He made a promise to himself never to be so foolish again.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl. She was only 3 years old. All she wanted was to have fun. One day, she saw a warm butterfly. She didn't know what it was. She was so curious, so she followed it. The butterfly flew around in circles until it landed on a flower. The little girl was full of joy! She ran up to the butterfly and said hello. The butterfly was friendly too. The girl knew she had found a new friend. She was so happy and said goodbye with big hug. The butterfly flew away and the girl watched it until it was out of sight. The girl was sad to see it go, but she knew she would never forget that warm butterfly.

chapters.title: Max was a young boy and…
p: Max was a young boy and he wanted to go on an adventure. He asked his mom if he could go outside and explore. And so, his mom said yes. Max was very excited and ran outside.
He ran across the lawn to a big tree. He looked up and thought it was the tallest thing he had ever seen.

Max wanted to go to the top so he started to climb. But it was very hard and he was scared because he was so young. Just then, he saw a ladder and he knew just what to do. He ran over and climbed up the ladder and soon he was at the top.

Max was so proud of himself. He looked around and it was a beautiful sight. He saw a castle in the distance and he pointed to it. He wanted to go there and explore. He asked his mom if he could and she said yes.
Max was excited and off he went. The castle was so much fun and he explored it all day. He was so young and it was a great adventure. He will never forget it.

chapters.title: Bella was a three year old…
p: Bella was a three year old who loved to bathe. Every night, she would splash around and make bubbles. One night, however, Bella tried something new. She put a lemon in her bath water. It smelled really nice. She thought it was very impressive! It was so much fun that she continued to do it every night.

When her mom came to check on her, she couldn't help but be amazed. Bella had created such a wonderful bath for herself. She asked Bella why she had chosen a lemon and Bella said, "It makes the water smell so nice." Her mom was so proud of her and impressed with her creativity.
From then on, Bella always asked her mom to add a lemon in her bath water. She loved taking luxurious baths with the citrus scent. Bellas' baths had become quite impressive.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was an ancient kitchen. Everything in the kitchen was old and still worked. One day, when the cook was making lunch, he sneezed. His sneeze started a chain reaction. The ancient oven began to shake and something started to move. The cook was very surprised! The cupboard opened up and something hidden for a long time was revealed. It was a treasure chest full of coins! The cook was so happy that he shouted out loud. He was going to be rich!

The cook was in such a good mood that he started to dance in the kitchen. He sneezed again and the ancient oven shook even harder. Suddenly, out of nowhere, a genie appeared in the kitchen! He said that the cook was granted three wishes!

The cook thought of what he wanted and wished for two more kitchens, one modern and one ancient. He also wished for an endless supply of coins. The genie granted his wish and disappeared in a puff of smoke.
The cook was very happy. He looked around and saw a beautiful modern kitchen and an ancient kitchen. He also saw a treasure chest full of coins! He was so thankful for his three wishes!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She was three years old and very brave. One day, she went to the beach with her family. The beach was quiet and the waves were gentle.
Amy wanted to try surfing. She was excited but a little scared. Her family showed Amy how to do it. She stood on the surfboard and tried to stay on it. She kept falling off but she didn't give up.

Finally, Amy was able to ride the surf for a few seconds! She was so proud of herself. But then the waves got bigger and she had to resist them. After a while, the waves became too strong and Amy had to give up trying. Even so, the feeling of riding the surf was amazing.
At the end of the day, Amy was happy and exhausted. She had learned a lot and could not wait to go surfing again.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a nice woman who had a big smile. She was very busy doing all sorts of things during the day. When it was time for her to rest, she would sit down, close her eyes and take a deep breath. She would then open her mouth wide and let out a big yawn.

The yawn was very loud, and it filled the room. The woman felt so calm and relaxed. She would stay in that peaceful moment for a long minute. Then, she opened her eyes and saw something very original. At the other end of the room, she could see a small tree with many different kinds of flowers.
The woman smiled at this beautiful sight. She was once again ready to do the things she had to do. But, she always remembered that peaceful minute filled with her big yawn.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to crawl. She would crawl around all day, exploring new places. But one day, she found something very special. She found a radish! It was a bright red colour and looked very crunchy. She grabbed the radish and instantly her hands got stuck! It was too tough for her to pull off.

The little girl was sad but then remembered she had a brilliant idea. She called out to her mom and asked if she had a knife. Mom quickly gave her a little knife and the girl carefully cut the radish off. It worked! She then happily ate the radish, crunching as she chewed it.
The little girl continued to crawl around and found more radishes. She would find them, cut them off with her knife and eat them each and every day.
The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a kind boy. He loved to imagine funny things. One day, he imagined that he was a giant peanut! He laughed and laughed, but then he started to get hungry.

He decided to go get some real peanuts from the kitchen. When he got there, he ran over to the pantry and opened the door. He saw a big jar filled with peanuts! He was so excited, he started to dance around the kitchen.

When he was done dancing, he grabbed a handful of peanuts and ran back to his room. He sat on the floor and started to eat his peanuts. With each crunchy bite, he imagined he was back in the kitchen dancing again. One by one, he ate the peanuts until they were all gone.
He had so much fun imagining and eating the peanuts, he knew he wanted to do it again soon. He smiled and thought that peanuts were very kind to let him imagine and have fun with them.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very excited. Her name was Millie and she lived near a playground.
One day, she asked her mom if she could go to the playground. She wanted to go and play with her friends. Her mom said yes and Millie was so happy!
When she got to the playground, she saw that there was a big loop. Millie and her friends wanted to ride it. Millie's mom told her that she could try it. Millie was so excited!
Millie jumped onto the loop, and her mom sent her around the loop. Millie was laughing and smiling as she went around. She felt like she was flying.
Millie and her friends played on the loop all day and when they were done, Millie was so tired that she fell asleep on the grass. Millie's mom smiled and sent her home with a hug.
The end.
